name: Liquid I.V. Sugar-Free Hydration Packet (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Replaces dextrose glucose with allulose and stevia. Without glucose, the sodium-glucose cotransporter (SGLT1) cannot pump water into the enterocytes. Furthermore, unabsorbed allulose draws fluid into the colon, frequently causing gas and diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active diarrhea. Always stick to the standard Liquid I.V. or Pedialyte with real glucose for true clinical rehydration.
